# Generated by Armada. Do not edit: changes are overwritten.
global
    stats socket /var/run/haproxy/admin.sock mode 600 level admin
    log stdout format raw local0
    maxconn 20000
    hard-stop-after 1h
    ssl-default-bind-options ssl-min-ver TLSv1.2 no-tls-tickets
    ssl-default-bind-ciphersuites TLS_AES_128_GCM_SHA256:TLS_AES_256_GCM_SHA384:TLS_CHACHA20_POLY1305_SHA256
    ssl-default-bind-ciphers ECDHE-ECDSA-AES128-GCM-SHA256:ECDHE-RSA-AES128-GCM-SHA256:ECDHE-ECDSA-AES256-GCM-SHA384:ECDHE-RSA-AES256-GCM-SHA384:ECDHE-ECDSA-CHACHA20-POLY1305:ECDHE-RSA-CHACHA20-POLY1305

defaults
    mode http
    log global
    option httplog
    option forwardfor
    retries 3
    option redispatch 1
    timeout connect 2s
    timeout client 60s
    timeout server 60s
    timeout http-request 10s
    timeout http-keep-alive 10s
    timeout queue 30s
    timeout tunnel 1h

frontend metrics
    bind 127.0.0.1:8404
    http-request use-service prometheus-exporter if { path /metrics }
    http-request return status 404

frontend http
    bind :80
    http-request redirect scheme https code 301

frontend https
    bind :443 ssl crt /usr/local/etc/haproxy/default.pem crt /usr/local/etc/haproxy/certs/ alpn h2,http/1.1
    http-request set-header X-Forwarded-Proto https
    http-request del-header Forwarded
    http-request del-header X-Forwarded-For
    http-request del-header CF-Connecting-IP
    http-request del-header True-Client-IP
    http-request del-header X-Forwarded-Host
    http-request del-header X-Forwarded-Port
    http-request del-header X-Forwarded-Prefix
    http-request del-header X-Forwarded-Server
    http-request set-var(txn.ext) bool(true)
    http-request set-var(txn.client) src
    http-request del-header X-Real-IP
    http-request set-header X-Real-IP %[var(txn.client)] if { var(txn.client) -m found }
    http-request set-var(txn.host) req.hdr(host),field(1,:),lower
    http-request set-var(txn.path) path
    default_backend be_armada_notfound

backend be_web
    balance roundrobin
    default-server check inter 2s fastinter 1s fall 2 rise 2 observe layer4 error-limit 2 on-error fastinter
    server s1 10.0.0.2:81
    server s2 10.0.0.3:82 inter 15s
    server s3 127.0.0.1:1 disabled
    server s4 127.0.0.1:1 disabled
    server s5 127.0.0.1:1 disabled
    server s6 127.0.0.1:1 disabled
    server s7 127.0.0.1:1 disabled
    server s8 127.0.0.1:1 disabled
    server s9 127.0.0.1:1 disabled
    server s10 127.0.0.1:1 disabled

backend be_armada_notfound
    http-request return status 404 content-type text/plain string "no app is configured for this host"
